(\n            &lt;img src={role.avatar} alt={role.name} className=\"w-6 h-6 rounded-full\" /&gt;\n          ) : (\n            &lt;div className=\"w-6 h-6 rounded-full bg-white/20 flex items-center justify-center\"&gt;\n              &lt;MessageSquare className=\"w-4 h-4\" /&gt;\n            &lt;/div&gt;\n          )}\n          &lt;span className=\"font-medium\"&gt;{role.name}&lt;/span&gt;\n        &lt;/div&gt;\n        &lt;div className=\"flex items-center gap-1\"&gt;\n          &lt;button\n            onClick={handleMinimize}\n            className=\"p-1 hover:bg-white/20 rounded transition-colors\"\n            title=\"最小化\"\n          &gt;\n            &lt;Minimize2 size={16} /&gt;\n          &lt;/button&gt;\n          &lt;button\n            onClick={onClose}\n            className=\"p-1 hover:bg-red-600 rounded transition-colors\"\n            title=\"关闭\"\n          &gt;\n            &lt;X size={16} /&gt;\n          &lt;/button&gt;\n        &lt;/div&gt;\n      &lt;/div&gt;\n\n      {/* 对话内容区域 */}\n      &lt;div className=\"flex-1 overflow-hidden\"&gt;\n        &lt;AIRoleChat roleConfig={role} compact={false} /&gt;\n      &lt;/div&gt;\n\n      {/* 调整大小控件 */}\n      &lt;div\n        className=\"absolute bottom-0 right-0 w-4 h-4 cursor-nw-resize\"\n        onMouseDown={handleResizeMouseDown}\n        style={{\n          background: 'linear-gradient(135deg, transparent 50%, #ccc 50%)',\n          borderRadius: '0 0 0.5rem 0'\n        }}\n      /&gt;\n    &lt;/div&gt;\n  );\n};\n\nexport default ChatWindow;",

        "contents": "export class WorkflowEngine {\nonProgress(callback: (execution: WorkflowExecution) =&gt; void) {\n\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * 执行工作流\n   */\n  async execute(\n    workflow: AgentWorkflow,\n    options: WorkflowExecutionOptions = {}\n  ): Promise&lt;WorkflowExecution&gt; {\n    if (this.isRunning) {\n      throw new Error('工作流正在执行中');\n    }\n\n    const mergedOptions = { ...DEFAULT_EXECUTION_OPTIONS, ...options };\n    this.isRunning = true;\n    this.isPaused = false;\n    this.isCancelled = false;\n\n    // 创建执行实例\n    const executionId = &#96;exec_${Date.now()}_${Math.random().toString(36).substring(7)}&#96;;\n    this.execution = {\n      id: executionId,\n      workflowId: workflow.id,\n      workflowName: workflow.name,\n      status: 'running' as WorkflowExecutionStatus,\n      sharedContext: {\n        workflowInput: mergedOptions.input || {},\n        nodeOutputs: {},\n      },\n      nodeResults: [],\n      startTime: new Date(),\n    };\n\n    // 初始化所有节点为pending状态\n    for (const node of workflow.nodes) {\n      this.execution.nodeResults.push({\n        nodeId: node.id,\n        status: 'pending',\n        startTime: new Date(),\n      });\n    }\n\n    this.notifyProgress();\n\n    try {\n      // 按照拓扑排序执行节点\n      const executionOrder = this.topologicalSort(workflow.nodes, workflow.edges);\n      await this.executeNodesInOrder(workflow, executionOrder, mergedOptions);\n      \n      this.execution.status = 'completed';\n      this.execution.endTime = new Date();\n      this.execution.duration = this.execution.endTime.getTime() - this.execution.startTime.getTime();\n    } catch (error) {\n      this.execution.status = 'failed';\n      this.execution.endTime = new Date();\n      this.execution.duration = this.execution.endTime.getTime() - this.execution.startTime.getTime();\n      this.execution.error = {\n        message: error instanceof Error ?         "contents": "export class LangGraphEngine {\nasync execute(workflow: any, options: { input?: any }): Promise&lt;{ executionId: string; message: string; data?: any }&gt; {\n\n      for (const level of order) {\n        const results = await Promise.allSettled(level.map(async (node: any) =&gt; {\n          // 条件边 gating：若有入边条件不满足则跳过\n          const incoming = inbound.get(node.id) || [];\n          if (incoming.length &gt; 0) {\n            const passAll = await this.evaluateIncomingConditions(incoming, sharedContext);\n            if (!passAll) return { status: 'skipped' };\n          }\n          return this.executeNode(node, sharedContext);\n        }));\n        results.forEach((res, idx) =&gt; {\n          const node = level[idx];\n          if (res.status === 'fulfilled') {\n            nodeResults.push({ nodeId: node.id, status: 'completed', output: res.value });\n            sharedContext.nodeOutputs[node.id] = res.value;\n          } else {\n            nodeResults.push({ nodeId: node.id, status: 'failed', error: res.reason?.message || '节点执行失败' });\n          }\n        });\n      }\n\n      const finalText = this.extractFinalText(nodes, sharedContext);\n      await workflowExecutionModel.update(execution.id, {\n        status: 'completed',\n        end_time: new Date().toISOString(),\n        duration: Date.now() - startedAt,\n        node_results: JSON.stringify(nodeResults),\n        shared_context: JSON.stringify(sharedContext),\n      } as any);\n\n      return {\n        executionId: execution.id,\n        message: finalText || '工作流执行完成',\n        data: {\n          outputs: {\n            text: finalText,\n            answer: finalText,\n            content: finalText,\n            metadata: { workflowId: workflow.id, executionId: execution.id, engine: 'langgraph' },\n          },\n          nodeResults,\n        },\n      };\n    } catch (error) {\n      await workflowExecutionModel.update(execution.id, {\n        status: 'failed',\n        end_time: new Date().toISOString()\n\n  }\n}",

        "contents": "export class AgentWorkflowService {\nasync executeWorkflow(\n    workflowId: string,\n    options: any\n  ): Promise&lt;{ executionId: string; message: string; data?: any }&gt; {\n\n\n      // 从 Agent 节点输出中提取 conversation_id（用于多轮对话）\n      let conversationId: string | null = null;\n      for (const [nodeId, nodeOutput] of Object.entries(sharedContext.nodeOutputs || {})) {\n        if (nodeOutput &amp;&amp; typeof nodeOutput === 'object' &amp;&amp; (nodeOutput as any).conversation_id) {\n          conversationId = (nodeOutput as any).conversation_id;\n          logger.info('从 Agent 节点输出中提取到 conversation_id', {\n            nodeId,\n            conversationId,\n          });\n          break;\n        }\n      }\n\n      // 记录最终提取的内容\n      logger.info('工作流执行完成，提取结果', {\n        workflowId,\n        executionId: execution.id,\n        hasContent: !!outputContent,\n        contentLength: outputContent?.length || 0,\n        nodeResultsCount: nodeResults.length,\n        nodeOutputsKeys: Object.keys(sharedContext.nodeOutputs || {}),\n        hasConversationId: !!conversationId,\n      });\n\n      // 如果有内容，确保 message 不会显示默认的 \"工作流执行完成\"\n      // 前端通常显示 message 字段，如果内容在 data.outputs.answer 中，\n      // 前端可能需要从那里取，或者我们直接把内容放在 message 中（如果不太长）\n      // 或者，如果内容很长，保持 message 为 \"工作流执行完成\"，但确保 data 中有完整内容\n      \n      // 但是，用户反馈说显示 \"工作流执行完成\"，说明前端可能优先展示 message\n      // 如果 outputContent 存在，我们应该将其作为 message 返回，或者返回一个更有意义的状态\n      \n      return {\n        executionId: execution.id,\n        message: outputContent ? '工作流执行成功' : '工作流执行完成', // 避免直接把长内容放在message里，除非是短文本\n        data: {\n          outputs: {\n            output: finalOutput || outputContent,\n            text: outputContent,\n            answer: outputContent,\n            content: outputContent,\n            conversation_id: conversationId || undefined, // 包含 conversation_id 用于多轮对话\n            metadata: {\n              workflowId,\n              executionId: execution.id,\n              nodeResults: nodeResults.length,\n              generatedAt: new Date().toISOString(),\n            },\n          },\n        },\n      };\n    } catch (error) {\n      logger.error('工作流执行失败',\n  }\n}",

        "contents": "export class WorkflowEngine {\n\n\n  /**\n   * 执行单个节点\n   */\n  private async executeNode(\n    workflow: AgentWorkflow,\n    node: AgentWorkflowNode,\n    options: Required&lt;WorkflowExecutionOptions&gt;\n  ): Promise&lt;void&gt; {\n    const nodeResult = this.execution!.nodeResults.find(r =&gt; r.nodeId === node.id);\n    if (!nodeResult) {\n      return;\n    }\n\n    nodeResult.status = 'running';\n    nodeResult.startTime = new Date();\n    this.notifyProgress();\n\n    try {\n      // 准备节点输入\n      const nodeInput = await this.prepareNodeInput(workflow, node, this.execution!.sharedContext);\n      nodeResult.input = nodeInput;\n\n      let output: any;\n\n      // 根据节点类型执行不同的逻辑\n      switch (node.type) {\n        case 'agent':\n          output = await this.executeAgentNode(node, nodeInput);\n          break;\n        case 'condition':\n          output = await this.executeConditionNode(node, nodeInput);\n          break;\n        case 'assign':\n          output = await this.executeAssignNode(node, nodeInput);\n          break;\n        case 'merge':\n          output = await this.executeMergeNode(node, workflow);\n          break;\n        case 'transform':\n          output = await this.executeTransformNode(node, nodeInput);\n          break;\n        case 'input':\n          output = await this.executeInputNode(node, options.input);\n          break;\n        case 'output':\n          output = await this.executeOutputNode(node, workflow);\n          break;\n        case 'memory':\n          output = await this.executeMemoryNode(node, workflow);\n          break;\n        default:\n          throw new Error(&#96;不支持的节点类型: ${node.type}&#96;);\n      }\n\n      nodeResult.status = 'completed';\n      nodeResult.output = output;\n      nodeResult.endTime = new Date();\n      nodeResult.duration = nodeResult.endTime.getTime() - nodeResult.startTime.getTime();\n\n      // 将输出保存到共享上下文\n      this.execution!.sharedContext.nodeOutputs[node.id] = output;\n\n    } catch (error) {\n      nodeResult.status = 'failed';\n      nodeResult.endTime = new Date();\n      nodeResult.duration =\n  }\n}",

        "contents": "export class AgentWorkflowService {\nasync executeWorkflow(\n    workflowId: string,\n    options: any\n  ): Promise&lt;{ executionId: string; message: string; data?: any }&gt; {\n(result, index) =&gt; {\n\n          if (result.status === 'fulfilled') {\n            const nodeOutput = result.value;\n            nodeResults.push({\n              nodeId: node.id,\n              status: 'completed',\n              output: nodeOutput,\n            });\n            sharedContext.nodeOutputs[node.id] = nodeOutput;\n            \n            // 记录节点执行结果（特别是Agent节点）\n            if (node.type === 'agent') {\n              logger.info('Agent节点执行完成', {\n                nodeId: node.id,\n                hasOutput: !!nodeOutput,\n                outputType: typeof nodeOutput,\n                outputKeys: nodeOutput &amp;&amp; typeof nodeOutput === 'object' ? Object.keys(nodeOutput) : null,\n                hasAnswer: nodeOutput &amp;&amp; typeof nodeOutput === 'object' ? !!nodeOutput.answer : false,\n                answerType: nodeOutput &amp;&amp; typeof nodeOutput === 'object' &amp;&amp; nodeOutput.answer ? typeof nodeOutput.answer : null,\n                answerLength: nodeOutput &amp;&amp; typeof nodeOutput === 'object' &amp;&amp; nodeOutput.answer &amp;&amp; typeof nodeOutput.answer === 'string' ? nodeOutput.answer.length : null,\n              });\n            }\n          } else {\n            nodeResults.push({\n              nodeId: node.id,\n              status: 'failed',\n              error: result.reason?.message || '节点执行失败',\n            });\n            logger.error(&#96;节点执行失败: ${node.id}&#96;, { error: result.reason });\n          }\n        });\n      }\n\n      // 提取输出节点的结果\n      const outputNode = nodes.find((n: any) =&gt; n.type === 'output');\n      let finalOutput: any = null;\n      let outputContent = '';\n\n      // 辅助函数：从输出对象中提取内容\n  }\n}",

        "contents": "export class AgentWorkflowService {\nasync executeWorkflow(\n    workflowId: string,\n    options: any\n  ): Promise&lt;{ executionId: string; message: string; data?: any }&gt; {\n\n          }\n          \n          if (extracted &amp;&amp; extracted.trim()) {\n            finalOutput = nodeOutput;\n            outputContent = extracted;\n            logger.info('从节点输出中提取内容成功', { \n              nodeId,\n              contentLength: outputContent.length,\n              contentPreview: outputContent.substring(0, 100),\n            });\n            break;\n          }\n        }\n      }\n\n      // 如果还是没有内容，但有 retriever_resources，尝试构建内容\n      if (!outputContent || !outputContent.trim()) {\n        for (const [nodeId, nodeOutput] of Object.entries(sharedContext.nodeOutputs || {})) {\n           const raw = (nodeOutput as any)?.raw;\n           const metadata = raw?.data?.metadata || raw?.metadata;\n           \n           if (metadata?.retriever_resources &amp;&amp; Array.isArray(metadata.retriever_resources) &amp;&amp; metadata.retriever_resources.length &gt; 0) {\n             logger.info('从节点输出中发现检索资源，构建引用内容', { nodeId });\n             \n             const resources = metadata.retriever_resources;\n             outputContent = &#96;已为您找到 ${resources.length} 条相关信息：\\n\\n&#96;;\n             \n             resources.forEach((res: any, index: number) =&gt; {\n               const title = res.document_name || res.title || &#96;文档 ${index + 1}&#96;;\n               const content = res.content || '';\n               const score = res.score ? &#96;(匹配度: ${(res.score * 100).toFixed(1)}%)&#96; : '';\n               \n               outputContent += &#96;### ${index + 1}. ${title} ${score}\\n${content}\\n\\n&#96;;\n             });\n             \n             finalOutput = nodeOutput;\n             break;\n           }\n        }\n      }\n\n      // 更新执行记录\n      await workflowExecutionModel.update(execution.id, {\n        status: 'completed',\n        end_time: new Date().toISOString(),\n        duration: Date.now() - startedAt,\n        node_results: JSON.stringify(nodeResults),\n        shared_context: JSON.stringify(sharedContext),\n      });\n\n      // 从 Agent 节点输出中提取 conversation_id（用于多轮对话）\n  }\n}",

        "contents": "CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS workflow_executions (\n    id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,\n    execution_type TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (execution_type IN ('agent_workflow', 'dify_workflow')),\n    \n    -- Agent工作流执行字段\n    workflow_id TEXT,                  -- 关联agent_workflows.id\n    workflow_name TEXT,\n    shared_context TEXT DEFAULT '{}',  -- JSON字符串，共享上下文\n    node_results TEXT DEFAULT '[]',    -- JSON字符串，节点执行结果列表\n    \n    -- Dify工作流执行字段\n    workflow_run_id TEXT UNIQUE,       -- Dify工作流运行ID\n    task_id TEXT,                      -- Dify任务ID\n    message_id TEXT,                    -- 关联chat_messages.message_id\n    app_type TEXT,                      -- 应用类型\n    \n    -- 通用执行字段\n    status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending',\n    error_message TEXT,                -- 错误信息\n    inputs TEXT,                        -- JSON格式存储输入\n    outputs TEXT,                       -- JSON格式存储输出\n    \n    -- 执行统计\n    elapsed_time REAL DEFAULT 0,        -- 执行时间（秒）\n    total_tokens INTEGER DEFAULT 0,\n    total_steps INTEGER DEFAULT 0,\n    duration INTEGER,                   -- 持续时间（毫秒，用于Agent工作流）\n    \n    -- 时间戳\n    start_time TIMESTAMP,              -- 开始时间\n    end_time TIMESTAMP,                -- 结束时间\n    started_at DATETIME,                -- 开始时间（Dify工作流）\n    finished_at DATETIME,              -- 完成时间（Dify工作流）\n    created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\n    updated_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\n    \n    FOREIGN KEY (workflow_id) REFERENCES agent_workflows(id) ON DELETE SET NULL,\n    FOREIGN KEY (message_id) REFERENCES chat_messages(message_id) ON DELETE SET NULL\n);\n\n-- 对话会话表\nCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS conversations (\n    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,\n    conversation_id TEXT UNIQUE NOT NULL, -- Dify返回的conversation_id",

        "contents": "export class AgentWorkflowModel {\nasync initializeTable(): Promise&lt;void&gt; {\n\n      }\n    }\n    \n    // 创建工作流执行表（统一结构，支持Agent工作流和Dify工作流）\n    // 注意：如果表已存在（通过迁移脚本创建），此CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS不会修改现有结构\n    const createExecutionTableSQL = &#96;\n      CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS workflow_executions (\n        id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,\n        execution_type TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (execution_type IN ('agent_workflow', 'dify_workflow')),\n        \n        -- Agent工作流执行字段\n        workflow_id TEXT,\n        workflow_name TEXT,\n        shared_context TEXT DEFAULT '{}',\n        node_results TEXT DEFAULT '[]',\n        \n        -- Dify工作流执行字段\n        workflow_run_id TEXT UNIQUE,\n        task_id TEXT,\n        message_id TEXT,\n        app_type TEXT,\n        \n        -- 通用执行字段\n        status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending',\n        error_message TEXT,\n        inputs TEXT,\n        outputs TEXT,\n        \n        -- 执行统计\n        elapsed_time REAL DEFAULT 0,\n        total_tokens INTEGER DEFAULT 0,\n        total_steps INTEGER DEFAULT 0,\n        duration INTEGER,\n        \n        -- 时间戳\n        start_time TIMESTAMP,\n        end_time TIMESTAMP,\n        started_at DATETIME,\n        finished_at DATETIME,\n        created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\n        updated_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\n        \n        FOREIGN KEY (workflow_id) REFERENCES agent_workflows(id) ON DELETE SET NULL,\n        FOREIGN KEY (message_id) REFERENCES chat_messages(message_id) ON DELETE SET NULL\n      );\n    &#96;;\n    \n    try {\n      await this.db.query(createExecutionTableSQL);\n    } catch (error: any) {\n      if (!error.message?.includes('already exists') &amp;&amp; !error.message?.includes('duplicate')) {\n        console.warn('创建workflow_executions表时出现警告:', error.message);\n      }\n    }\n\n    // 如果表已存在但缺少新字段，尝试添加（向后兼容）\n  }\n}",

        "contents": "export class ChatMessageService {\n\n\n  /**\n   * 保存工作流执行记录\n   */\n  static async saveWorkflowExecution(execution: WorkflowExecutionRecord): Promise&lt;WorkflowExecutionRecord&gt; {\n    // 生成唯一ID（如果没有提供）\n    const executionId = &#96;exec_${Date.now()}_${Math.random().toString(36).substring(7)}&#96;;\n    \n    const sql = &#96;\n      INSERT INTO workflow_executions (\n        id, execution_type, workflow_run_id, task_id, message_id, workflow_id, app_type, \n        status, error_message, inputs, outputs, \n        elapsed_time, total_tokens, total_steps, \n        started_at, finished_at, created_at, updated_at\n      ) VALUES (?, 'dify_workflow', ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)\n    &#96;;\n    \n    await query(sql, [\n      executionId,\n      execution.workflow_run_id,\n      execution.task_id,\n      execution.message_id,\n      execution.workflow_id,\n      execution.app_type,\n      execution.status,\n      execution.error_message,\n      execution.inputs,\n      execution.outputs,\n      execution.elapsed_time || 0,\n      execution.total_tokens || 0,\n      execution.total_steps || 0,\n      execution.started_at,\n      execution.finished_at\n    ]);\n\n    return await this.getWorkflowExecutionById(execution.workflow_run_id) as WorkflowExecutionRecord;\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * 根据workflow_run_id获取工作流执行记录\n   */\n  static async getWorkflowExecutionById(workflowRunId: string): Promise&lt;WorkflowExecutionRecord | null&gt; {\n    \n  }\n}",

        },
        "contents": "export class AgentWorkflowService {\n\n\n  /**\n   * 执行工作流（异步）\n   */\n  async executeWorkflow(\n    workflowId: string,\n    options: any\n  ): Promise&lt;{ executionId: string; message: string; data?: any }&gt; {\n    // 引擎分发：当请求指定 engine=langgraph 或工作流配置为 langgraph 时，走 LangGraphEngine\n    const workflowForEngine = await agentWorkflowModel.getById(workflowId);\n    if (!workflowForEngine) {\n      throw new Error('工作流不存在');\n    }\n\n    let engineSelected: 'native' | 'langgraph' = 'native';\n    if (options?.engine === 'langgraph') {\n      engineSelected = 'langgraph';\n    } else if (workflowForEngine.metadata) {\n      try {\n        const meta = JSON.parse(workflowForEngine.metadata as any);\n        if (meta?.engine === 'langgraph') engineSelected = 'langgraph';\n      } catch {}\n    }\n\n    if (engineSelected === 'langgraph') {\n      const workflow = await agentWorkflowModel.getById(workflowId);\n      if (!workflow) {\n        throw new Error('工作流不存在');\n      }\n      const engine = new LangGraphEngine();\n      return await engine.execute(workflow, { input: options.input });\n    }\n    // 获取工作流定义\n    const workflow = workflowForEngine;\n\n    const startedAt = Date.now();\n    // 创建执行实例\n    const execution = await workflowExecutionModel.create({\n      execution_type: 'agent_workflow',\n      workflow_id: workflowId,\n      workflow_name: workflow.name,\n      status: 'running',\n      shared_context: options.input || {},\n      node_results: [],\n      start_time: new Date().toISOString(),\n      // 记录引擎\n      inputs: { engine: options?.engine || 'native' } as any,\n    });\n\n    try {\n      // 解析工作流节点和边\n      const nodes = JSON.parse(workflow.nodes);\n  }\n}",

        "contents": "export class WorkflowExecutionModel {\n\n\n  /**\n   * 创建执行实例（支持Agent工作流和Dify工作流）\n   */\n  async create(data: CreateWorkflowExecutionDTO): Promise&lt;WorkflowExecution&gt; {\n    await this.ensureConnection();\n\n    const id = data.id || &#96;exec_${Date.now()}_${Math.random().toString(36).substring(7)}&#96;;\n    const status = data.status || 'pending';\n    const executionType = data.execution_type;\n\n    const sql = &#96;\n      INSERT INTO workflow_executions (\n        id, execution_type, workflow_id, workflow_name, shared_context, node_results,\n        workflow_run_id, task_id, message_id, app_type,\n        status, error_message, inputs, outputs,\n        elapsed_time, total_tokens, total_steps, duration,\n        start_time, end_time, started_at, finished_at,\n        created_at, updated_at\n      ) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)\n    &#96;;\n\n    const params = [\n      id,\n      executionType,\n      // Agent工作流字段\n      data.workflow_id || null,\n      data.workflow_name || null,\n      data.shared_context ? JSON.stringify(data.shared_context) : null,\n      data.node_results ? JSON.stringify(data.node_results) : null,\n      // Dify工作流字段\n      data.workflow_run_id || null,\n      data.task_id || null,\n      data.message_id || null,\n      data.app_type || null,\n      // 通用字段\n      status,\n      data.error_message || null,\n      data.inputs ? JSON.stringify(data.inputs) : null,\n      data.outputs ? JSON.stringify(data.outputs) : null,\n      data.elapsed_time || null,\n      data.total_tokens || null,\n      data.total_steps || null,\n      data.duration || null,\n      // 时间戳\n      data.start_time || null,\n      data.end_time || null,\n      data.started_at || null,\n      data.finished_at || null,\n    ];\n\n    await this.db.query(sql, params);\n\n    return await this.getById(id) as WorkflowExecution;\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * 根据ID获取执行实例\n   */\n  async getById(id: string): Promise&lt;WorkflowExecution | null&gt; {\n    await this.ensureConnection();\n  }\n}",

        "contents": "-- 更新workflow_executions表结构以支持统一表\n-- 版本: 2.0.0\n-- 创建日期: 2025-01-XX\n-- 说明: 将workflow_executions表更新为统一结构，支持Agent工作流和Dify工作流\n\n-- 由于SQLite的限制，我们需要重新创建表\n-- 步骤：\n-- 1. 创建临时表保存旧数据\n-- 2. 删除旧表\n-- 3. 创建新表\n-- 4. 迁移数据\n-- 5. 删除临时表\n\n-- 创建临时表保存旧数据\nCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS workflow_executions_old AS SELECT * FROM workflow_executions;\n\n-- 删除旧表和相关索引\nDROP TABLE IF EXISTS workflow_executions;\n\n-- 创建新表（统一结构）\nCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS workflow_executions (\n    id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,\n    execution_type TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (execution_type IN ('agent_workflow', 'dify_workflow')),\n    \n    -- Agent工作流执行字段\n    workflow_id TEXT,                  -- 关联agent_workflows.id\n    workflow_name TEXT,\n    shared_context TEXT DEFAULT '{}',  -- JSON字符串，共享上下文\n    node_results TEXT DEFAULT '[]',    -- JSON字符串，节点执行结果列表\n    \n    -- Dify工作流执行字段\n    workflow_run_id TEXT UNIQUE,       -- Dify工作流运行ID\n    task_id TEXT,                      -- Dify任务ID\n    message_id TEXT,                    -- 关联chat_messages.message_id\n    app_type TEXT,                      -- 应用类型\n    \n    -- 通用执行字段\n    status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending',\n    error_message TEXT,                -- 错误信息\n    inputs TEXT,                        -- JSON格式存储输入\n    outputs TEXT,                       -- JSON格式存储输出\n    \n    -- 执行统计\n    elapsed_time REAL DEFAULT 0,        -- 执行时间（秒）\n    total_tokens INTEGER DEFAULT 0,\n    total_steps INTEGER DEFAULT 0,\n    duration INTEGER,                   -- 持续时间（毫秒，用于Agent工作流）\n    \n    -- 时间戳\n    start_time TIMESTAMP,              -- 开始时间\n    end_time TIMESTAMP,                -- 结束时间\n    started_at DATETIME,                -- 开始时间（Dify工作流）",

        "contents": "export class WorkflowService {\n  // 执行节点\n  static async executeNode(\n    nodeId: string, \n    inputData: any, \n    context: WorkflowContext\n  ): Promise&lt;NodeExecutionResult&gt; {\n    const node = getNodeById(nodeId);\n    if (!node) {\n      return { success: false, error: '节点不存在' };\n    }\n\n    const config = nodeConfigs[nodeId];\n    if (!config) {\n      return { success: false, error: '节点配置不存在' };\n    }\n\n    try {\n      // 验证输入数据\n      const validationResult = this.validateNodeInput(nodeId, inputData);\n      if (!validationResult.valid) {\n        return { success: false, error: validationResult.error };\n      }\n\n      // 根据节点类型执行不同的逻辑\n      let result: any;\n      switch (node.type) {\n        case 'smart_search':\n          result = await this.executeSmartSearch(inputData);\n          break;\n        case 'tech_package':\n          result = await this.executeTechPackage(inputData, context);\n          break;\n        case 'promotion_strategy':\n          result = await this.executePromotionStrategy(inputData, context);\n          break;\n        case 'core_draft':\n          result = await this.executeCoreDraft(inputData, context);\n          break;\n        case 'speech':\n          result = await this.executeSpeech(inputData, context);\n          break;\n        default:\n          return { success: false, error: '不支持的节点类型' };\n      }\n\n      // 生成下一步推荐\n      const nextRecommendations = this.generateNextStepRecommendations(\n        nodeId, \n        result, \n        context\n      );\n\n      return {\n        success: true,\n        data: result,\n        nextRecommendations\n      };\n    } catch (error) {\n      return {\n        success: false,\n        error: error instanceof Error ? error.message : '执行失败'\n      };\n    }\n  }\n\n  // 验证节点输入\n  private static validateNodeInput(nodeId: string, inputData: any): { valid: boolean; error?: string } {\n    \n  }\n}",

        "contents": "/**\n * Workflow执行可视化组件\n * 实时显示工作流执行状态、节点进度和结果\n */\nconst WorkflowExecutionView: React.FC&lt;WorkflowExecutionViewProps&gt; = ({\n  execution,\n  onPlay,\n  onPause,\n  onStop,\n  onResume,\n  isLoading = false,\n}) =&gt; {\n  const [expandedNodes, setExpandedNodes] = useState&lt;Set&lt;string&gt;&gt;(new Set());\n  const [selectedNode, setSelectedNode] = useState&lt;string | null&gt;(null);\n\n  // 切换节点展开状态\n  const toggleNodeExpansion = (nodeId: string) =&gt; {\n    const newExpanded = new Set(expandedNodes);\n    if (newExpanded.has(nodeId)) {\n      newExpanded.delete(nodeId);\n    } else {\n      newExpanded.add(nodeId);\n    }\n    setExpandedNodes(newExpanded);\n  };\n\n  if (!execution) {\n    return (\n      &lt;div className=\"bg-white border border-gray-200 rounded-lg p-8 text-center\"&gt;\n        &lt;Clock className=\"w-16 h-16 text-gray-400 mx-auto mb-4\" /&gt;\n        &lt;p className=\"text-gray-600\"&gt;等待开始执行...&lt;/p&gt;\n      &lt;/div&gt;\n    );\n  }\n\n  const { status, nodeResults, startTime, endTime, duration, error } = execution;\n  \n  // 计算总体进度\n  const totalNodes = nodeResults.length;\n  const completedNodes = nodeResults.filter(r =&gt; r.status === 'completed').length;\n  const failedNodes = nodeResults.filter(r =&gt; r.status === 'failed').length;\n  const progress = totalNodes &gt; 0 ? (completedNodes / totalNodes) * 100 : 0;\n\n  // 获取状态图标和颜色\n  const getStatusIcon = (nodeStatus: NodeExecutionStatus) =&gt; {\n    switch (nodeStatus) {\n      case 'completed':\n        return &lt;CheckCircle2 className=\"w-5 h-5 text-green-600\" /&gt;;\n      case 'running':\n        return &lt;Loader className=\"w-5 h-5 text-blue-600 animate-spin\" /&gt;;\n      case 'failed':\n        return &lt;AlertCircle className=\"w-5 h-5 text-red-600\" /&gt;;\n      case 'skipped':\n        return &lt;Circle className=\"w-5 h-5 text-gray-400\" /&gt;;\n      case 'pending':\n      default:\n        return &lt;Circle className=\"w-5 h-5 text-gray-300\" /&gt;;\n    }\n  };\n\n  const getStatusColor = (nodeStatus: NodeExecutionStatus) =&gt;\n;\n;",

        "contents": "/**\n * 执行Agent工作流\n * POST /api/v1/agent-workflows/:id/execute\n */\nrouter.post('/:id/execute', async (req, res) =&gt; {\n  try {\n    const { id } = req.params;\n    const { input, options } = req.body;\n    \n    const result = await agentWorkflowService.executeWorkflow(id, {\n      input,\n      ...options,\n    });\n    \n    res.json(formatApiResponse(true, result, '工作流执行已开始'));\n  } catch (error) {\n    console.error('执行工作流失败:', error);\n    \n    if (error instanceof Error &amp;&amp; error.message.includes('不存在')) {\n      return res.status(404).json(formatApiResponse(false, null, error.message));\n    }\n    \n    res.status(500).json(formatApiResponse(\n      false,\n      null,\n      '执行工作流失败',\n      error instanceof Error ? error.message : '未知错误'\n    ));\n  }\n});\n\n/**\n * 编译Agent工作流（支持LangGraph）\n * POST /api/v1/agent-workflows/:id/compile\n */",

        "contents": "export class WorkflowExecutionModel {\n\n\n  /**\n   * 更新执行实例\n   */\n  async update(id: string, updates: Partial&lt;WorkflowExecution&gt;): Promise&lt;WorkflowExecution&gt; {\n    await this.ensureConnection();\n\n    const existing = await this.getById(id);\n    if (!existing) {\n      throw new Error(&#96;执行实例不存在: ${id}&#96;);\n    }\n\n    // 构建动态更新SQL\n    const updateFields: string[] = [];\n    const params: any[] = [];\n\n    if (updates.status !== undefined) {\n      updateFields.push('status = ?');\n      params.push(updates.status);\n    }\n    if (updates.shared_context !== undefined) {\n      updateFields.push('shared_context = ?');\n      params.push(updates.shared_context ? JSON.stringify(updates.shared_context) : null);\n    }\n    if (updates.node_results !== undefined) {\n      updateFields.push('node_results = ?');\n      params.push(updates.node_results ? JSON.stringify(updates.node_results) : null);\n    }\n    if (updates.workflow_run_id !== undefined) {\n      updateFields.push('workflow_run_id = ?');\n      params.push(updates.workflow_run_id);\n    }\n    if (updates.task_id !== undefined) {\n      updateFields.push('task_id = ?');\n      params.push(updates.task_id);\n    }\n    if (updates.message_id !== undefined) {\n      updateFields.push('message_id = ?');\n      params.push(updates.message_id);\n    }\n    if (updates.app_type !== undefined) {\n      updateFields.push('app_type = ?');\n      params.push(updates.app_type);\n    }\n    if (updates.error_message !== undefined) {\n      updateFields.push('error_message = ?');\n      params.push(updates.error_message);\n    }\n    if (updates.inputs !== undefined) {\n      updateFields.push('inputs = ?');\n      params.push(updates.inputs ? JSON.stringify(updates.inputs) : null);\n    }\n    if (updates.outputs !== undefined) {\n      updateFields.push('outputs = ?');\n      params.push(updates.outputs ? JSON.stringify(updates.outputs) : null);\n    }\n    if (updates.elapsed_time !== undefined) {\n      updateFields.push('elapsed_time = ?');\n  }\n}",
